BL-1318 — Pack launch refuses to staff a role with a model the steward has not cleared FOR THAT ROLE — global `certified` is not per-role clearance
What it solves: Severity `high`, not `critical`: the swarm is not down, and the live exposure
was mitigated in the same session (df10a5e4de restaffed both Bob packs' QA to
`cursor/auto`). It is not `medium` because the mitigation is a hand edit that
any future pack or relaunch re-opens — the broken safety signal i…
Approval context: The refuse-until-cleared invariant is firm (human directive verbatim in `source:`, plus an explicit "Yes go ahead"). What is NOT settled is the shape of the operator escape hatch. The intake names two forms in the same breath — `--override-uncertified` and "env skip, same spirit as LOCAL_CODER_BATT…
